record.question: BRICS stands for
options: Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa
Bangladesh, Romania, Indonesia, Cambodia and Sudan
Belgium, Romania, Italy, Canada and Saudi Arabia
Belize, Rwanda, Iran, Cameroon and Senegal
record.explanation: Answer A: Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa. At the April 2019 date, BRICS comprised Brazil, Russia, India, China and South Africa. These five names form the conventional expansion of the acronym. The original External Affairs 2017–18 report supplies that grouping, matching option A in this appearance. Historical/source note: The acronym’s five-country expansion and 2018 membership; later enlargement does not change this historical answer. Reference: https://www.mea.gov.in/uploads/publicationdocs/29788_mea-ar-2017-18-03-02-2018.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
